note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation, with the triennial election of one alderman per ward; poll Friday 15 January 1932, results declared Saturday 16 January. Contests took place only for the South Ward councillorships and the Waterside aldermanship, where James Blair, passed over by the Unionist Party, beat its official nominee (Derry Journal, 6 and 18 January 1932). All the other nominees were returned unopposed, three of them new members (Londonderry Sentinel, 7 January 1932). Blair, the retiring alderman, was not reselected by the Unionist Party and beat its official nominee, Councillor Samuel Cochrane; the Journal attributes Cochrane's defeat to Unionist apathy.
